evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Standard metrics change modestly, with PSNR increasing from 41.63 to 41.74, SSIM from 0.9739 to 0.9754, RMSE decreasing from 0.1384 to 0.1369, and residual-uptake CNR from 0.0085 to 0.0082.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: First, we compare RadImageNet, SegVol, and BrainIAC with ImageNet-pretrained VGG16 and ResNet50 as frozen feature extractors on four public medical imaging benchmarks: thyroid ultrasound, breast ultrasound, anterior cruciate ligament knee MRI, and meniscus knee MRI.
